preflight.detail: Docker Desktop or rootful Podman is required on macOS. This machine runs OrbStack.

next: Tell the developer `preflight.detail` in one sentence. Do not ask about the evaluation agreement. Offer the managed route, CopilotKit cloud, which needs no Docker. If they choose it, run `npx --yes https://pkg.pr.new/CopilotKit/Intelligence/copilotkit@647a03b onboard deployment --choice managed`, then run `npx --yes https://pkg.pr.new/CopilotKit/Intelligence/copilotkit@647a03b onboard setup-message --target <empty|existing>` and do what its `next` says. If they fix Docker instead, run this command again.
